title: VisionFund Insurance Report Spec
description: Machine-readable specification for the Cupboard Week Insurance Impact Report auto-generator. One spec file per report run; the pipeline loops over parts → subsections and executes each entry.

parts.description: Exactly 7 parts (the Golden Framework). Code must verify part_ids are unique and span 1–7 in order.

name.description: Human-readable report name, e.g. 'VFI Insurance Impact Report 2026 – ASIA'

template_version.description: Version of the report template this spec was authored against, e.g. '2.0'

reporting_period.description: ISO date range or descriptive label, e.g. '2025-01 to 2025-12'

priority_segments.description: Report-wide default disaggregation segments. Individual subsections may override or extend this list.

benchmark_dataset_id.description: Identifier of the regional benchmark dataset for overlay comparisons. Required if any metric uses benchmark_comparison method.

title.description: Part title exactly as it appears in the template, e.g. 'Product Understanding'

subsections.description: Numbered subsections plus exactly one insight subsection. Code must verify each part ends with a subsection whose id matches N.insight.

question_ref.description: Stable snake_case key matching a column in the survey data dictionary, e.g. 'q_coverage_understanding'

question_text.description: Human-readable question text for documentation and review

response_type.description: Response scale / type; informs which statistical methods are valid for this variable

conditional_on.description: question_ref of the gating question when this is a skip-logic branch

variables.description: question_ref(s) the method is applied to. Code must verify each ref appears in the subsection's source_questions.

against.description: Second variable for two-variable methods. Code must enforce: required when method is correlation, significance_test, or gap_analysis.

top_n.description: For frequency_rank: number of ranked items to surface. Code must enforce: required when method is frequency_rank.

label.description: Short human-readable label for this metric in generated output

benchmark_source.description: Identifier of the external benchmark dataset. Code must enforce: required when method is benchmark_comparison.

priority.description: required = always compute this cut regardless of cell size; nice_to_have = compute only when n >= minimum threshold

powerbi_name.description: Exact name of the Power BI visual as labelled in the Insurance Impact Dashboard (the single source of truth)

source.description: powerbi_screenshot: a human pastes the image; auto_generated: the pipeline creates it from data

description.description: One-line description of what the visual shows; used to populate the placeholder caption in the report

questions.description: question_refs for open-text fields to analyze

verbatims_required.description: If true, the output must include representative client verbatims with profile tags

verbatim_count.description: Target number of verbatims. Code must enforce: required when verbatims_required is true.

verbatim_profile_fields.description: Client profile fields to attach to each verbatim. Template standard is: gender, age, branch, claimant_status.

theme_method.description: Theme extraction method. genai_then_manual = AI first pass then human review (template default).

client_protection_flag.description: If true, surface any conduct or protection signals as a separate block regardless of how few responses mention them

subtheme_frequency_unit.description: How subtheme frequencies are expressed. count is recommended at low volume to avoid misleading percentages.

separate_concern_categories.description: Theme categories to report in separate blocks, e.g. ['pricing_concerns', 'service_claims_concerns', 'conduct_flags']

subsection_id.description: Dot-notation id matching the Golden Framework, e.g. '1.1', '3.2', '5.insight'. Part prefix must match the enclosing part's part_id (code-level check).

title.description: Subsection title as it appears in the report template

word_cap.description: Maximum word count for prose outputs. Null is valid only when outputs contains no analysis_prose or insight_prose (code-level check).

source_questions.description: Survey questions that feed this subsection. Empty array is valid only for insight/synthesis subsections with fill_mode bespoke.

metrics.description: Computations the pipeline must run. Must be non-empty for auto or hybrid subsections (enforced by if/then below).

disaggregation.description: Segments to cut by. Code must verify no duplicate segment values within this array.

visual.description: Dashboard visual to embed. Null for insight/synthesis subsections which have no dedicated visual.

qualitative.description: Config for open-text analysis. Null when the subsection has no qualitative component.

benchmark_overlay.description: Whether to overlay the regional benchmark on the visual. Requires report_metadata.benchmark_dataset_id to be set (code-level check).

outputs.description: What the writer or pipeline must produce for this subsection. At least one is always required.

allOf.description: auto/hybrid subsections must declare at least one metric OR a non-null qualitative config
auto/hybrid subsections must declare at least one source question so the pipeline knows what data to fetch
